about_the_game:
Buried Cargo is a first-person automation game where you interact with the world entirely through a terminal.

You play as a lone maintenance robot that wakes up inside a shipping container, buried deep under the remains of a forgotten civilization.

Use realistic terminal commands to connect to conveyor units, printers, extractors, and scanners.

Set up production lines, expand your small base and unlock blueprints buried within layers of broken tech.

Build your own factory from the inside out, not with a UI full of buttons, but through a clean, readable command line interface.

Key Features

  • Procedural Scrap World: Expand your container through walls of randomized scrap. Each cell hides new materials and rare resources.

  • Modular Automation: Deploy units, install blueprints, and create production chains using conveyor belts, extractors, printers, and refiners.

  • Terminal-Based Gameplay: Every interaction happens in a simple text interface. Connect, configure, and control units using real command syntax.

  • No Tech Tree: Blueprints are discovered, not unlocked. Scan and disassemble scrap to find the tools you need.

  • Controller & Steam Deck Support: Designed to be played comfortably with both mouse/keyboard and controller, including full Steam Deck support.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core CPU, 2.5 GHz (e.g., Intel i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-compatible GPU with 2 GB VRAM (e.g., NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Supports Steam Deck

short_description: Buried Cargo is a terminal-driven automation game. Wake up as a lone maintenance robot, buried beneath a dead world. Use realistic command-line controls to connect machines, extract scrap, and build a factory one command at a time. No tech trees. No UI. Just code, junk, and logic.
